02 — HOW I BUILD

The Product Process

01

Find the Problem

Identify acute real-world friction where users are bogged down by opaque data or messy workflows.

02

Understand User

Map the exact journey, edge cases, and emotional stakes of students or daily operators.

03

Design Experience

Craft high-clarity typography, intuitive touch targets, and eliminate unnecessary UI noise.

04

Build Product

Architect robust database models, fast APIs, and responsive frontends that perform reliably.

05

Iterate & Polish

Refine micro-interactions, optimize loading states, and continuously shave off friction.

● 04 — ABOUT ME

Hi, I'm Aryan.

I'm a developer and product builder currently pursuing bachelors at NIT Agartala. I love taking complex, disorganized problems in the real world — like state counselling cutoffs, student academic ecosystems, or personal decision dilemmas — and building calm, reliable digital products that people can actually use.

My work combines product intuition with full-stack engineering across modern mobile and web ecosystems.
